sub: Exclusive themed kits filled with surprises to fuel your creativity, only for subscribers.

json_ld.description:
Bring floral beauty to your everyday notes with this coordinated set of three B6 softcover notebooks, featuring artwork inspired by the beloved Wildflowers Collection.
Each notebook showcases a distinct design while coordinating beautifully together:


Cream Floral Bouquet Lined – Soft ivory background with vibrant hand-painted blooms and lush greenery.

Wildflower Meadow Graph – A rich, dark floral pattern bursting with colorful blossoms reminiscent of a summer garden.

Periwinkle Stripe Dot Grid – Delicate blue stripes accented with petite floral sprigs for a fresh, vintage-inspired look.

With three complementary floral designs ranging from bright botanical bouquets to soft vintage florals, this notebook set adds a touch of garden-inspired charm wherever your ideas take root.
These soft cover books can also be paired with our Soft Cover Set
json_ld.name: B6 Softcover Notebooks - Set of 3
